title: Choose how your presenter view is laid out in PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams
summary: PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams now lets presenters choose from four presenter view layouts to suit their style, without affecting attendees' view. This feature, available on Windows, Mac, and web, rolls out worldwide from mid to late November 2026 and requires no admin action.
body:
[What and Why:]

Presenters using PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams can now choose a layout for their presenter view. They can pick the one that best fits how they like to present, whether that's focusing on speaker notes, moving between slides quickly, looking ahead to what's next, or keeping the view simple.

[Rollout Schedule:]

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out on mid November 2026 and expect to complete by late November 2026.

[Impact on Your Organization:]

Presenters can switch between these layouts while they present:

Notes and thumbnails (default): Speaker notes and slide thumbnails, the same view presenters have today.

 Thumbnails on the left: Slide thumbnails along the left side for quick navigation.

 Next slide preview: A preview of the next slide or animation, so presenters can see what's coming.

 Slides only: A simpler view focused on the current slide.

 To change the layout, the presenter selects "Change layout" while presenting. Layouts only change what the presenter sees. Attendees' view of the presentation isn't affected.

This feature is available in Teams on Windows, Mac and the web.

This feature is on by default.

[Action Required/Recommendations:]

No admin action is required. You may want to let presenters in your organization know about the new layout options and update any internal training or documentation as needed.

[Compliance considerations:]

No compliance considerations identified, review as appropriate for your organization.
